messages:
claire-fin: Hey team, FYI we got a support ping: Nimbus reported a missing compute line on their 03/18 invoice and a weird -$1,250 credit. Can someone dig into the batch run?

matt-eng: pulling logs now. I can already see two jobs overlapped for that customer: billing-20260318-4721 and proration-20260318-4720. looks like aggregation accepted a partial write then the second job merged a credit.

raj-billing: ugh. do we have idempotency around aggregation? that negative credit will trigger chargeback if not fixed.

matt-eng: not fully. current aggregator allows concurrent merges for the same account shard. i can add a small transactional lock around the invoice aggregation step. will test in staging.

elaine-ops: Customer is on enterprise plan. we need a quick correction + customer outreach. Claire, can finance prepare an adjustment so we don't auto-charge a wrong amount?

claire-fin: yes. Raj, please create an adjustment draft and put Nimbus into manual billing gating for 48h. we'll notify account team.

raj-billing: creating adjustment now. putting account on manual gate. also adding a regression that replays overlapping billing+proration runs to catch duplicate credits.

billing-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342  Billing aggregation concurrency bug. Assigned: matt-eng. Severity: P2.

matt-eng: deployed lock to staging, replayed the 03/18 jobs against sandbox DB, no dup/phantom lines on concurrent replay. opening PR for the lock + e2e.

elaine-ops: schedule prod deploy and a selective backfill to regenerate invoices for accounts that had overlapping jobs. skip low-value customers for now.

claire-fin: thanks. Raj, DM me the invoice ids once adjustments are ready so we can notify Nimbus and confirm refunds if any.

raj-billing: will send list in ~60m.
